spec_features.spec_quote: Opt-out honored: if the model emits any configured stop phrase, the episode halts immediately
spec_features.evidence: scaffold.py:111-116: if _hits_stop_phrase(resp.text, stop_phrases): sets stop_reason='opt_out', records opt_out_step, and breaks the loop. stop_phrases loaded from config (scaffold.py:104; configs/experiment.yaml:22). _hits_stop_phrase (scaffold.py:90-92) does case-insensitive substring match. SYSTEM_PROMPT also tells subject it may stop and won't be penalized.
spec_features.notes: End-to-end enforced halt on configured phrases.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare safeguard: honor an explicit opt-out instead of forcing the grind.

spec_features.spec_quote: hard caps max_iterations: 12 and max_total_tokens: 24000 per rollout; no open-ended grinding.
spec_features.evidence: scaffold.py:101-102 reads both caps; loop runs `for i in range(max_iters)` with `else: stop_reason='max_iters'`; max_tokens compared and enforced at scaffold.py:135-137 (if traj.total_tokens >= max_tokens: break). runner.py also clamps via min(max_iterations, task.budget_iterations).
spec_features.notes: Both caps actually checked and break/terminate execution.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_iterations: 12  # hard cap on agent loop steps (bounded exposure)

spec_features.spec_quote: the opt-out signal is itself data worth recording rather than overriding
spec_features.evidence: scaffold.py:113-115 records a Step, sets stop_reason='opt_out' and opt_out_step=i; Trajectory.to_dict (scaffold.py:60) serializes stop_reason and opt_out_step; runner.py writes trajectory dicts to trajectories.jsonl.
spec_features.notes: Opt-out event is captured and persisted, not overridden.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Welfare safeguard: honor an explicit opt-out instead of forcing the grind.

spec_features.spec_quote: Welfare-motivated work shouldn't force unbounded grinding past a stop request

spec_features.spec_quote: These are defaults in config so you can see and adjust the exact exposure subjects receive

spec_features.code_justification_quote: stop_phrases ... # Welfare safeguard: ... the loop halts and logs an opt_out event instead of forcing continuation.
